info.title: TyloInfer native server
info.description: Native management, text sessions, public model discovery and the Anthropic Messages subset. OpenAI chat schema and media APIs remain pending. See docs/backend-protocol.md, docs/backend-stage3.md and docs/backend-compatibility.md for lifecycle and limits.

get.description: Requires jobs scope. Lists the two downloadable repository kinds; model lifecycle retains its typed routes.

post.description: Requires jobs scope. Only failed/cancelled/interrupted downloads may retry. Creates a new job and validates the repository manifest before reusing partials. Active or succeeded jobs return 409; no automatic restart replay.

put.description: Requires models scope. A directory ID comes from the model directory browser; null resets to the workspace models directory. Enabling cache reclamation returns 501.

get.description: Requires inference scope. Lists model files and groups downloadable weights; estimates and popularity metadata are unavailable (null). Hugging Face pins the commit; ModelScope requires SHA-256 for each file.

post.description: Requires models scope. Accepts owner/name or an HTTPS repository URL on huggingface.co or modelscope.cn. Arbitrary URLs, credentials, query strings and revision URL suffixes are rejected.

get.description: Requires inference scope. Read persisted original model name to public alias mappings, including unloaded models.

put.description: Requires admin scope. Replace all aliases atomically. Targets must be registered or loaded, with unique names. Aliases cannot shadow model names, artifact IDs or instance IDs. Empty values and values equal to the original name remove the mapping. Failed validation or persistence leaves the saved mapping and routing unchanged. Concurrent model operations return 409.

get.description: Requires inference scope. Anthropic-Version, Anthropic-Beta or X-Api-Key selects Anthropic endpoints; otherwise returns OpenAI endpoints.

Registered native-supported models and healthy loaded instances; requires inference scope. Metadata queries do not load models. Advertises configured aliases, otherwise original names; ambiguous names use artifact or instance IDs. Anthropic headers or X-Api-Key select a paginated Anthropic list. Other requests return the OpenAI list. Names are sorted. Creation time is an epoch sentinel, not the load time.
Anthropic model detail for an advertised model, or a loaded instance selected by name or ID; requires inference scope. Does not load models.

post.description: Requires inference scope. Validates fields and reserves a connection slot before acquiring a registered or loaded model. Concurrent requests for the same artifact share one load result; successful stream headers follow loading and native submission. Disconnect cancels waiting or native generation, but does not abort shared synchronous loading. Request body limit is 1 MiB; collected output or retained tool arguments are limited to 16 MiB and 128 calls. Native cancellation returns 409 before streaming, or an SSE error after headers. Count/stop-string/budget gaps return 501.

200.description: Native message or Anthropic SSE. message_start has initial usage zero; message_delta supplies final native usage. Local thinking has an empty signature. Events: message_start, content_block_start/delta/stop, optional ping, message_delta, message_stop; error replaces a successful terminal on failure.

post.description: Requires inference scope. Exact prompt counting is not exposed by the native runtime; this route always returns 501 after authorization.

200.description: Ordered history; at most 16 MiB of parts and 10000 messages
Text archive; media archives return media_unavailable

post.description: Input, running response and revision commit atomically before model acquisition. Loading happens outside the transaction; queries and cancellation remain available. SSE can report processing before loading finishes. Loading or native-profile validation failures become saved failed replies. Before native submission, cancelled/failed replies have null usage and performance. Duplicate request_id replays a terminal result without loading; changed content conflicts. The synchronous load owner finishes its factory before finalizing cancellation. SSE terminal events follow persistence.

200.description: Persistent result or ordered session SSE frames

schema.description: event/id/data frames, sequence starts at zero; see docs/backend-stage3.md

post.description: Requests native cancellation and returns the current record, which may still be running. Read the original stream or response list for the terminal result.

get.description: Requires jobs scope. Lists unarchived jobs, newest first with ID as the tie-breaker. Filters may be combined; offset counts only matching visible rows. Empty or invalid filter values return 400.

post.description: Requires jobs scope. Queues a single model repository download. Files are verified and published as one directory. Other job kinds return 501. Source/filesystem failures are recorded on the job; shutdown and cancellation retain resumable partials.

delete.description: Requires jobs scope. Atomically archives all visible succeeded, failed, cancelled and interrupted jobs. Active work is unchanged; job rows, events and artifact associations remain stored. Does not unload models or remove files.

204.description: Terminal history archived, including an already empty history

delete.description: Requires jobs scope. Archives one terminal job. Queued, running and cancelling jobs return 409. Archived jobs disappear from list, detail, cancel and event endpoints. Existing event streams stop with an error if they observe archival. Job rows, events and artifact associations remain stored; files and model instances are unchanged.

200.description: Ordered SSE with sequence IDs; post-header failures use an error event.

JobError.description: Structured task error. Active history returns job_state_conflict; missing or archived jobs return operation_not_found. Failed archive transactions leave visible history unchanged.

ModelError.description: Structured model error. Validation, identity conflicts and persistence failures do not change aliases.

AnthropicError.description: Anthropic error envelope; no successful terminal is emitted for cancellation or failure.

SessionError.description: Structured failure; save failures include execution_status and saved=false in details

destination.description: Relative destination below the selected download root; an initial models/ is removed. Existing directories are never overwritten.

expected_bytes.description: Optional capacity hint; remote file sizes and checksums govern verification.

aliases.description: Original model name to public alias. After trimming ASCII whitespace, each alias has at most 255 Unicode characters and no ASCII control characters. The response contains normalized nonempty mappings.

mfq_session_id.description: Optional native KV cache session ID; not a persisted chat session.

thinking.description: Adaptive and disabled map to native enable_thinking. Explicit budgets return 501 after validation; conflicting enable_thinking returns 400.

stop_sequences.description: Empty is accepted. Nonempty arrays return 501 until native terminal events expose the matched stop string.

MessageRequest.description: Basic Anthropic 2023-06-01 subset. Tool uses/thinking require assistant; tool results require user. Tool names must be unique; a named choice must exist in tools. Sampling defaults come from the native model profile. Media is passed to the native input validator; this route does not fetch or decode it.

parts.description: Existing media parts are preserved when reading old databases

SessionSampling.description: Explicit sampling overrides; omitted fields use the loaded model runtime profile.

reasoning_effort.description: Non-null values require a native control not yet available

CreateSessionResponse.description: Only the settings and request fields listed here are accepted; stream is excluded from the idempotency fingerprint

LoadPolicy.description: Pinned instances cannot specify an idle timeout. Omitted timeout disables idle eviction.

metrics_age_ms.description: Age of the native metrics snapshot, in milliseconds, when this instance representation was produced. Metrics may be cached; request counters are read separately.

progress.description: Zero while phase-only progress is unknown; one on success.
